name: silo
description: Earned, bounded trust for scripts — capability fingerprinting + a bundle-injected enforcing broker, with a release-age cooldown installer.

scripts.build:core: [ -d node_modules/@oxc-parser/binding-wasm32-wasi ] || npm i --no-save --force @oxc-parser/binding-wasm32-wasi@0.140.0; vite build vscode -c vscode/core.config.ts
scripts.dev: vite build vscode -c vscode/entry.config.ts && npm run build:core && vite vscode
scripts.build: vite build vscode -c vscode/entry.config.ts && npm run build:core && vite build vscode
